name: anakin
description: Anakin web data platform (MCP Server + Skills). Scrape pages to markdown, map and crawl sites, run AI search and deep research, execute pre-built Wire actions across hundreds of popular websites, monitor pages for changes, compare AI answer engines, and drive a real cloud browser with natural language.

interface.longDescription: Turn any website into clean markdown or structured JSON. Run AI search and multi-source deep research, execute pre-built Wire actions across hundreds of popular sites, watch pages for changes on a schedule, and drive a real cloud browser from natural language.
defaultPrompt: Scrape this URL and give me the key details as JSON.
Research this topic across multiple sources and summarize what they agree on.
Watch this product page and tell me when the price changes.
